MatchCta.heading: Not sure where to start?
MatchCta.body: Answer a few quick questions and see how well universities and programs fit what matters to you.

MatchQuiz.heading: Find My Match
MatchQuiz.tagline: A few quick questions to help us match you with universities and programs that fit — this uses what's already in your profile plus a handful of new questions.
MatchQuiz.profileSummaryTitle: We'll use this from your profile
MatchQuiz.profileSummaryHint: Want to change any of this? <editProfileLink>Edit your profile</editProfileLink> — your answers here are just for this match run.
MatchQuiz.summaryDestinationsEmpty: Not set — matching against all countries
MatchQuiz.summaryDegreeEmpty: Not set — matching against all degree types
MatchQuiz.profileMissingWarning: Add these to your profile for better matches:
MatchQuiz.environmentQuestion: What kind of campus environment do you prefer?
MatchQuiz.sizeQuestion: What size university are you looking for?
MatchQuiz.workQuestion: How important is it to work part-time or do internships while studying?
MatchQuiz.scholarshipQuestion: Do you need scholarships or financial aid to make this work?
MatchQuiz.scholarshipYes: Yes, financial aid matters a lot
MatchQuiz.scholarshipNo: No, or not a major factor
MatchQuiz.reviewHint: We'll score demo universities against your profile and these answers.

MatchResults.realWhyLocationWithin: In one of your preferred countries
